what: Surface pictures for the kit's materials. tools/fal_textures.py asks fal.ai for each 'prompt' and saves textures/<material>/source.png; tools/make_pbr.py turns that into basecolor, normal and orm maps. 'tile_m' is how many metres one copy of the picture covers in the game; 'tint' multiplies the picture (1 = as generated); 'roughness' is [wettest, driest]. Optional per material: 'style' replaces the shared style, 'seed' fixes the generation, 'crop' keeps only that centre fraction of the picture (the model sometimes draws a framed slab). 'atlas': true marks the colour map of a fal 3D model (meshes/models.json): used as is, not made tileable, and fal_textures.py skips it.
style: seamless tileable texture, the surface fills the entire frame edge to edge, no border, no frame, no background, macro close-up photo seen straight on, soft even lighting, muted natural colors, photorealistic, highly detailed, 4k PBR material scan

M_Flesh.prompt: wet raw meat surface, dark red and purple muscle tissue with fine fibres, pale fat streaks, mucus sheen, irregular and organic

M_Flesh_Dark.prompt: dark rotting flesh, almost black maroon tissue, wrinkled and folded, wet slime in the folds

M_Heart.prompt: wet raw heart muscle surface, dark crimson and maroon tissue with pale fat patches and thin dark branching vessels, slimy, irregular
